tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS text message from your TextForAgents number.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read your recent inbound text messages.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_inbox · Public sink: send_sms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_inbox · Public sink: send_sms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
